active_fill.description: Background of the focused window's tab.
active_fill.label: Active tab colour

active_text.description: Icon and label colour on the focused tab. Pair this with the active tab colour so the text stays readable.
active_text.label: Active tab text

char_advance.description: Average character width as a fraction of the font size, used to convert the character limits below into a pixel budget. Raise it if labels look cramped, lower it if the strip stops short of the width you allowed.
char_advance.label: Character width estimate

enable_close.description: Show a close button on the tab. Middle-clicking a tab closes it regardless of this setting.
enable_close.label: Close button

enable_maximize.description: Show a maximize toggle on the tab.
enable_maximize.label: Maximize button

font_size.description: Font size of the tab labels.
font_size.label: Label size

hide_when_empty.description: Take no room on the bar when the focused workspace has no windows.
hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty

icon_size.description: Size of the application icon on each tab. Set to 0 to hide icons and show labels only.
icon_size.label: Icon size

inactive_text.description: Icon and label colour on unfocused tabs.
inactive_text.label: Inactive tab text

max_title_chars.description: Longest a tab label ever gets, even when there is room to spare.
max_title_chars.label: Maximum title length

max_total_width.description: Pixels the whole tab strip may occupy. Labels shrink to fit, then tabs drop to icons only, then the surplus collapses into a +N chip.
max_total_width.label: Maximum strip width

min_title_chars.description: Shortest a label may shrink to before tabs give up labels entirely and go icon-only.
min_title_chars.label: Minimum title length

show_controls.description: When to show the maximize and close buttons on a tab. Their space is reserved either way, so the strip never shifts under the cursor.
show_controls.label: Window controls
